handover_protocol.rule: Live GitHub state outranks this snapshot. Fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, CI/deployments, concurrent branches and generated child-programme state before mutation.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Legal Corpus First

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable rights/source qualification, provenance/attribution classification, bounded measurement, protected prewrite, implementation, ordinary CI/deployment and source-audit work. Stop at genuine human/security/cost/source-rights/topology/unrecoverable blockers, owner-authenticated production-write gates, or continuation boundaries.
operating_contract.rights: Fail closed. Private runtime creates no reuse permission. Unknown or materially unresolved rights are held or rejected. Every admitted cohort must carry exact provenance plus attribution/disclosure classification.
operating_contract.storage: Protected recipe bodies remain in private Cloudflare D1. GitHub contains only public code and public-safe evidence/artifacts. Browser-direct protected database access is forbidden.
operating_contract.authentication: Every protected request remains server-side authenticated and authorized through the application-owned identity verifier, exact allowlist and secure session. Do not weaken or emulate the owner authentication gate.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure, billing enablement or automatic overage authorization.
operating_contract.topology: Exactly two protected recipe-body D1 shards. No third shard is authorized.
operating_contract.d1_budget: v8011 implementation preserves the existing maximum of 16/16 D1 subqueries with zero assumed headroom.
operating_contract.public_activation: Public runtime remains 85 recipes and broader public corpus/recommendation activation is not authorized.
operating_contract.source_authority: Historical provenance is not authority for cultural authenticity, nutrition, allergens, dietary classification, scaling or medical claims.

youtube_culinary.authority_note: Do not mutate or manually retry YT-CUL from the corpus lane.

active_human_gate.precondition: Verify the production origin serves the merged v8011 runner, then use a current same-browser Culinary owner session.
active_human_gate.action: Owner opens the production v8011 runner and selects Run / resume v8011.
active_human_gate.stop_if: Production runner is unavailable/stale, or any runner failure, auth/session error, binding error, free-limit fail-closed result, fingerprint mismatch, route/body verification mismatch, hydration/rollback mismatch, unexpected D1 budget result, or other non-PASS terminal.

legal_corpus_baseline.reason: v8011 is implemented and merged but has not crossed the owner-authenticated production population gate. LEGAL_CORPUS_BASELINE_PASS must be separately reassessed rather than inferred from recipe count alone.

after_pass: write v8011 live PASS evidence and closeout documentation
verify active pointer v8011 and exact 13,124 composition
verify eleven-layer hydration, rollback/fail-closed proof, idempotent replay and <=16 D1 subqueries
fresh-rebase source discovery against live v8011 / 13,124 while preserving all provenance/rights holds
select the next rights-clean source candidate or bound marginal source value
reassess LEGAL_CORPUS_BASELINE_PASS without automatically opening downstream lanes
next_iteration.no_autonomous_crossing: The owner-authenticated production-write gate cannot be crossed by CI or repository automation.

not_authorized: No v8011 production D1 population without the owner-authenticated browser gate.
No paid infrastructure or billing/automatic overage authorization.
No broader public recipe corpus activation.
No Nutrition or recommendation lane mutation before roadmap authority.
No YT-CUL mutation/retry from the corpus lane.
No Knowledge Core mutation from the app lane unless separately authorized.
No automatic cultural-authenticity, nutrition, allergen, dietary or scaling authority from historical provenance.
No automatic declaration of LEGAL_CORPUS_BASELINE_PASS from v8011 implementation or future live PASS alone.
stop_conditions: The current owner-authenticated v8011 production-write gate.
Paid infrastructure or billing would be required.
Two-shard topology proves insufficient and a third shard would be required.
A runtime operation exceeds or requires expansion beyond the existing 16 D1-subquery ceiling.
Marginal source value becomes too low.
A genuine unrecoverable technical error occurs.
